# NEXSUS

NEXSUS is an independent operating company based in Casablanca, Morocco.

Website: https://nexsus.ma/
Contact: contact@nexsus.ma
Founder: Haytam Krimi
Founder email: haytam.krimi@nexsus.com

## Focus Areas

- AMARIS: creative direction, brand identity, production, digital experiences, editorial systems.
- PROJECTS: construction, interiors, fit-out, space design, public sector contracts, material sourcing.
- TECHNOLOGY & SOLUTIONS: enterprise software, SaaS platforms, digital products, B2B consulting, cloud architecture.
- VENTURES: consumer brands, proprietary products, new ventures, strategic investments, incubation.

## Location

Casablanca, Morocco. Serving Morocco, North Africa, and international partners.
